responsibility: Implements compact long-term storage for GCC vrange objects. It allocates type-specific storage slots for integer and floating ranges, serializes irange pair lists plus nonzero-bit masks and frange endpoint/NaN state into allocator-managed memory, reconstructs live vrange objects from those slots, and enforces fit and canonicalization rules needed by persistent range caches and global range information.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable logic behind the storage abstractions declared in value-range-storage.h. This .cc allocates slots, serializes and restores irange/frange contents, checks fit, and performs read/write canonicalization for stored range data.
